items.title: 53571_Mary Lou Williams oral history interview
items.q: Barney Josephson was very nice. I wrote the "Zodiac Suite" during that period and he put on a concert at Town Hall.

ctx.x: Why did you leave Cafe Society?

Well, I didn't leave. It kind of petered out a little, you know what I mean, after years and years of being there. There was a kind of a lull and so I just drifted away, went back to GLASER Glen and he booked me out of the city. You know to stay in the city for 5 years straight you have to keep presenting people with something new. Barney Josephson was very nice. I wrote the "Zodiac Suite" during that period and he put on a concert at Town Hall.
